outputs.explanation: The bar graph shows ** (p<0.01) significance indicators comparing HMGB1 signal intensity across genotypes/compartments, but the caption for panel A only states 'The mean ± SD are shown in the lower graph' and does not name the statistical test used to generate the ** annotations.

The bar graph reports the percentage of aggregate-positive Purkinje cells with no asterisks, p-values, or other significance markers shown; the caption states the ratio 'did not differ' without a quantitative significance indicator, so no test needs to be named.

The 9-week and 21-week rotarod line plots carry asterisks marking significant differences between groups on specific days, but the panel E caption ('The data are presented as mean ± SD') does not name the statistical test used to determine these significance marks.

outputs.from_the_caption: Student's t-test; one-way ANOVA followed by post hoc Tukey's HSD test
